query:
UPDATE
            account
        SET
            eulen_id = $2,
            updated_at = $3
        WHERE
            id = $1
        RETURNING
            id as "id!: uuid::Uuid",
            public_key as "public_key!: crypto::PublicKey",
            eulen_id,
            created_at as "created_at!: time::OffsetDateTime",
            updated_at as "updated_at!: time::OffsetDateTime"
